findingMatrix.change: Guard optional profile fields, delete optional SDK references, contextual exact role/read-grant option type, type-only module import and explicit real HTTPS factory return type. No any/ts-ignore/new lint waiver.

Require CONTEXT_LOST for genuine A Producer under otherwise current B context; require IDENTITY_MISMATCH for A envelope at B URL; record only exact scalar code/status. Assert B accepting, active, no binding and no A secret after producer refusal and after real valid B context checkpoint following identity refusal.

Require A inventory nonempty with bytes>0 and containsA before stop; match actual disposed tag. Immediately after B context before foreign metadata or credential delivery require distinct inventory tag, containsA=false/containsB=false plus runtime no-A/no-binding. After actual B fill require the same B tag containsB=true/containsA=false and one native entry. No initial size=0 requirement.

Original stdout/stderr receiver/args/return forwarding with numeric streaming prefixes, byte/call counters and per-canary/variant hit counts only. Existing diagnostic callback forwards to original stderr effect. Both-canary callback/profile/journal scans and final scalar evidence scan before write. Synchronous pre-original-close/pre-deletion scans also run on failing paths. Planted Unicode/reserved-character values make URI and Unicode escape variants distinct without modifying F/S fixture bytes.

Register F/S/directory/descriptors/callback cleanup immediately on acquisition; unwind construction failures while retaining original error. Post-SDK setup rejection closes original acquired context, restores descriptors and propagates original failure. Existing owned GuidedLaunchFailure cleanup is invoked with its original capability. Final cleanup releases close gate promptly, shares an absolute 5000ms cleanup-await budget, attempts all releases even after timeout/failure, restores descriptors, clears worker/client/setup references, retains unresolved FAIL rather than inventing writer quiescence and preserves primary test errors.

encodingCoverage.distinctness: Both planted values contain non-ASCII and URI-reserved characters. URI, double URI, UTF16BE, hex, base64 and JSON non-ASCII escapes differ from literal UTF8. A NFC/NFD differ; B sharp-s NFC/NFD are equal and are not represented as independent distinct variants.
encodingCoverage.outputInstrumentation: Transient current chunks and known comparison buffers only; retained streaming state is numeric prefix progress and scalar hit/call/byte counters. No retained chunks, raw inventory arrays, mock archives or secret-derived digests.

cleanupLimits: The 5000ms test cleanup await budget does not renew any production lease or action/start/run deadline. After it expires every remaining release is still invoked once, with immediate bounded await; unconfirmed work stays unresolved.

A bounded wait cannot force SDK or server promise settlement. Outstanding underlying operations may remain pending; tests must fail honestly and no mutable files are declared quiescent merely because an await timed out.
PID witness samples descendants at SDK launch settlement, not continuous discovery of all future descendants. Historical/actual complete-process-tree proofs remain separately scoped.

Journal directory is retained if tracked writers remain alive. Original production close owns profile disposal. Failure cleanup scans every recorded extant owned root before close/deletion; setup records the actual SDK profile parent so partially acquired roots can also be scanned.

Primary failures are rethrown unchanged. Cleanup failure state is recorded in scalar evidence and is itself a test failure when there was no prior error. Construction cleanup emits separate scalar failure evidence; evidence writing can itself remain unconfirmed under the same budget.
